definitions.explanation: Large-scale social or political disorder, including riots, revolts, and periods of instability. Often used to describe historical periods of conflict or significant social disruption.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{動乱|どうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
⟦{幕末|ばくまつ}→幕末：12531_bakumatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{動乱|どうらん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read a novel depicting the turmoil at the end of the Edo period.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治的|せいじてき}→政治的：05684_seijiteki⟧な{動乱|どうらん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}き→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国外|こくがい}→国外：20936_kokugai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}した→避難する：26827_hinansuru⟧。
examples.english: Amid ongoing political upheaval, many citizens fled the country.

notes: A literary and formal word often found in news reporting and historical writing. Common collocations: {動乱|どうらん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (era of turmoil), {動乱|どうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ (to fall into turmoil), ⟦{政治的|せいじてき}→政治的：05684_seijiteki⟧{動乱|どうらん} (political upheaval). The {朝鮮動乱|ちょうせんどうらん} is a formal Japanese name for the Korean War. Compare with ⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧ (confusion, disorder — more general and milder) and ⟦{暴動|ぼうどう}→暴動：15533_boudou⟧ (riot — a specific violent act).
